## Purpose and Entry Points
DeepTutor is a Python 3.11+ agent-native personalized learning workspace: chat, tutoring, research, solving, quiz/mastery, visualization, book generation, knowledge retrieval, and persistent companions share context and services. Primary launches are the `deeptutor` CLI and FastAPI server: `deeptutor/__main__.py`, `deeptutor_cli/main.py`, `deeptutor/api/run_server.py`. The browser client is a Next.js 16 application rooted at `web/app/layout.tsx`; Docker packages frontend and backend together via `Dockerfile` and `compose.yaml`.

## Runtime Composition and Request Boundary
Runtime bootstrap establishes workspace paths, configuration, capability/tool registries, and orchestration before accepting requests. `deeptutor/runtime/launcher.py` launches the local stack; `deeptutor/runtime/orchestrator.py` coordinates turns; `deeptutor/runtime/registry/capability_registry.py` and `deeptutor/runtime/registry/tool_registry.py` resolve enabled functionality. FastAPI routers expose HTTP endpoints and a unified WebSocket stream through `deeptutor/api/main.py` and `deeptutor/api/routers/unified_ws.py`. The Next.js proxy is the browser-facing boundary in container deployments (`web/proxy.ts`), forwarding `/api` and `/ws` internally.

## Agentic Turn Engine
The shared agent loop is the core control flow: request context and selected capability produce model messages, dispatch tools, append observations, stream labeled progress, and finish or pause for user input. Core abstractions sit in `deeptutor/core/agentic/loop.py`, `deeptutor/core/agentic/tool_dispatch.py`, and `deeptutor/core/stream_bus.py`. Default chat adapts this engine in `deeptutor/agents/chat/agent_loop.py` and `deeptutor/agents/chat/chat_agent.py`. Capability plugins provide specialized loops—solve, mastery, Obsidian, and subagents—behind a common protocol in `deeptutor/capabilities/protocol.py` and `deeptutor/capabilities/registry.py`.

## Models, Tools, and Execution Boundaries
LLM access is provider-abstracted, supporting OpenAI-compatible endpoints plus Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, GitHub Copilot, Codex, and local/cloud routing. Key seams are `deeptutor/services/llm/factory.py`, `deeptutor/services/llm/provider_registry.py`, and `deeptutor/services/llm/client.py`; embeddings use parallel adapters under `deeptutor/services/embedding/client.py`. Tools mount based on turn context and permissions, including search, RAG, file operations, memory, and subagent consultation (`deeptutor/tools/rag_tool.py`, `deeptutor/tools/web_search.py`, `deeptutor/tools/exec_tool.py`). Generated-code execution crosses an explicit sandbox boundary implemented by `deeptutor/services/sandbox/service.py`, with an optional runner sidecar at `deeptutor/services/sandbox/runner/server.py`.

## Knowledge and Context Layer
Knowledge bases ingest documents, parse them, build versioned indexes, and provide retrieval to chat, books, and partners. Lifecycle management is in `deeptutor/knowledge/manager.py`; parser selection and normalization are in `deeptutor/services/parsing/service.py`; RAG routing is in `deeptutor/services/rag/service.py`. Pluggable retrieval backends include LlamaIndex, GraphRAG, LightRAG, and PageIndex, represented by `deeptutor/services/rag/pipelines/llamaindex/pipeline.py`, `deeptutor/services/rag/pipelines/graphrag/pipeline.py`, and `deeptutor/services/rag/pipelines/pageindex/pipeline.py`. Sessions build sticky and one-turn source context through `deeptutor/services/session/context_builder.py`.

## Persistent Learning State and Isolation
File-backed workspace state includes sessions, attachments, notebooks, knowledge bases, books, skills, and inspectable three-layer memory. Session persistence supports SQLite or PocketBase through `deeptutor/services/session/unified_session_manager.py`, `deeptutor/services/session/sqlite_store.py`, and `deeptutor/services/session/pocketbase_store.py`. Memory records trace events and consolidates curated/synthesized facts in `deeptutor/services/memory/store.py` and `deeptutor/services/memory/consolidator/`. Optional multi-user mode scopes resource paths, identities, grants, and access checks under `deeptutor/multi_user/context.py`, `deeptutor/multi_user/grants.py`, and `deeptutor/multi_user/router.py`.

## Higher-Level Learning Products and External Channels
Specialized pipelines reuse the shared model, context, and tool layers: research (`deeptutor/agents/research/pipeline.py`), question generation (`deeptutor/agents/question/pipeline.py`), visualization (`deeptutor/agents/visualize/pipeline.py`), math animation (`deeptutor/agents/math_animator/pipeline.py`), and typed “living book” compilation (`deeptutor/book/engine.py`, `deeptutor/book/compiler.py`). Partners turn inbound web/IM messages into scoped chat turns; channel adapters span Slack, Discord, Telegram, Feishu, Matrix, Teams, and others via `deeptutor/partners/channels/manager.py` and `deeptutor/services/partners/runtime.py`. The web UI renders these surfaces from workspace routes such as `web/app/(workspace)/home/[[...sessionId]]/page.tsx`, `web/app/(workspace)/book/page.tsx`, and `web/app/(utility)/knowledge/page.tsx`.
